# Flagsmith API Reference

Flagsmith's Core and SDK APIs. Check out <a href='https://docs.flagsmith.com'>Flagsmith documentation</a>.

## API Reference

### Flagsmith API

Path: `/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html`
Version: v1

Flagsmith's Core and SDK APIs. Check out <a href='https://docs.flagsmith.com'>Flagsmith documentation</a>.

#### Operations

##### POST /api/v1/analytics/flags/

Class to handle flag analytics events

Responses:
- 201: No response body

##### POST /api/v1/auth/logout/

Use this endpoint to logout user (remove user authentication token).

Responses:
- 204: No response body

##### POST /api/v1/cb-webhook/

Endpoint to handle webhooks from chargebee.

Payment failure and payment succeeded webhooks are filtered out and processed
to determine which of our subscriptions are in a dunning state.

The remaining webhooks are processed if they have subscription data:

 - If subscription is active, check to see if plan has changed and update if so. Always update cancellation date to
   None to ensure that if a subscription is reactivated, it is updated on our end.

 - If subscription is cancelled or not renewing, update subscription on our end to include cancellation date and
   send alert to admin users.

Responses:
- 200: No response body

##### PUT /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/api-keys/{id}/

Manage server-side SDK keys for an environment.

Parameters:
- `environment_api_key` (path, string, required)
- `id` (path, integer, required) - A unique integer value identifying this environment api key.

Request body: application/json, application/x-www-form-urlencoded, multipart/form-data

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/{cohort_id}/

Request cohort deletion. Memberships are drained from identity data first; the cohort and its segment are deleted once drained.

Parameters:
- `cohort_id` (path, integer, required) - A unique integer value identifying this cohort.
- `environment_api_key` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 202: No response body

##### DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/sync-keys/{prefix}/

Revoke a cohort sync key.

Parameters:
- `environment_api_key` (path, string, required)
- `prefix` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 204: No response body

##### DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiment-metrics/{id}/

Manage experiment metrics for an environment.

Parameters:
- `environment_api_key` (path, string, required)
- `id` (path, integer, required) - A unique integer value identifying this metric.

Responses:
- 204: No response body

##### DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiments/{experiment_experiment_id}/metrics/{id}/

Manage metrics for an experiment.

Parameters:
- `environment_api_key` (path, string, required)
- `experiment_experiment_id` (path, string, required)
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 204: No response body

##### DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiments/{experiment_id}/

Manage experiments for an environment.

Parameters:
- `environment_api_key` (path, string, required)
- `experiment_id` (path, integer, required) - A unique integer value identifying this experiment.

Responses:
- 204: No response body

##### DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/featurestates/{id}/

View set to manage feature states. Nested beneath environments and environments + identities
to allow for filtering on both.

Parameters:
- `environment_api_key` (path, string, required)
- `id` (path, integer, required) - A unique integer value identifying this feature state.

Responses:
- 204: No response body

##### DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/identities/{identity_pk}/featurestates/{id}/

View set to manage feature states. Nested beneath environments and environments + identities
to allow for filtering on both.

Parameters:
- `environment_api_key` (path, string, required)
- `id` (path, integer, required) - A unique integer value identifying this feature state.
- `identity_pk` (path, integer, required)

Responses:
- 204: No response body

##### DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/warehouse-connections/{connection_id}/

Manage data warehouse connections for an environment.

Parameters:
- `connection_id` (path, integer, required) - A unique integer value identifying this warehouse connection.
- `environment_api_key` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 204: No response body

##### DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/webhooks/{id}/

Manage webhooks for an environment.

Parameters:
- `environment_api_key` (path, string, required)
- `id` (path, integer, required) - A unique integer value identifying this webhook.

Responses:
- 204: No response body

##### GET /api/v1/features/download-feature-export/{feature_export_id}/

This endpoint is to download a feature export file from a specific environment

Parameters:
- `feature_export_id` (path, integer, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /api/v1/features/download-flagsmith-on-flagsmith/

This endpoint is to download a feature export to enable Flagsmith on Flagsmith

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /api/v1/features/feature-segments/{id}/

Deletes a segment override. Applies to environments without v2 feature versioning (use_v2_feature_versioning: false).

Parameters:
- `id` (path, integer, required) - A unique integer value identifying this feature segment.

Responses:
- 204: No response body

##### GET /api/v1/flags/

Retrieve the feature flags for an environment.

---
*Note*: when providing the `feature` query argument, this endpoint will
return either a single object or a 404 (if the feature does not exist) rather
than a list.

---
*Note*: using this endpoint with an identifier is deprecated.
Please use `/api/v1/identities/?identifier=<identifier>` instead.

Parameters:
- `feature` (query, string, optional) - Name of the feature to get the state of

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /api/v1/flags/{identifier}

Retrieve the feature flags for an environment.

---
*Note*: when providing the `feature` query argument, this endpoint will
return either a single object or a 404 (if the feature does not exist) rather
than a list.

---
*Note*: using this endpoint with an identifier is deprecated.
Please use `/api/v1/identities/?identifier=<identifier>` instead.

Parameters:
- `feature` (query, string, optional) - Name of the feature to get the state of
- `identifier` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /api/v1/oauth/authorize/

Process a consent decision and return the redirect URI.

Responses:
- 200: No response body

##### DELETE /api/v1/projects/{project_pk}/features/{feature_pk}/mv-options/{id}/

Deletes a multivariate option.

Parameters:
- `feature_pk` (path, integer, required)
- `id` (path, integer, required) - A unique integer value identifying this multivariate feature option.
- `project_pk` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 204: No response body

##### POST /api/v1/analytics/telemetry/

Class to handle telemetry events from self hosted APIs so we can aggregate and track
self hosted installation data

Request body: application/json, application/x-www-form-urlencoded, multipart/form-data

Responses:
- 201

##### POST /api/v1/auth/login/

Class to handle throttling for login requests

Request body: application/json, application/x-www-form-urlencoded, multipart/form-data

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /api/v1/auth/login/code/

Override class to add throttling

Request body: application/json, application/x-www-form-urlencoded, multipart/form-data

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/webhook/cohorts/{id}/members/add/

Add members to a CSV cohort. Accepted deltas are applied to identity data asynchronously. Re-adding a member is a no-op, so retries are safe.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json, application/x-www-form-urlencoded, multipart/form-data

Responses:
- 200: No response body

##### POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/webhook/cohorts/{id}/members/remove/

Remove members from a CSV cohort. Accepted deltas are applied to identity data asynchronously. Removing a non-member is a no-op, so retries are safe.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json, application/x-www-form-urlencoded, multipart/form-data

Responses:
- 200: No response body

##### GET /api/v1/environment-feature-versions/{id}/

This is an additional endpoint to retrieve a specific version without needing
to provide the environment or feature as part of the URL.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/api-keys/

Manage server-side SDK keys for an environment.

Parameters:
- `environment_api_key` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json, application/x-www-form-urlencoded, multipart/form-data

Responses:
- 201

#### Models

- EnvironmentFeatureVersionRetrieve
- TokenCreate
- Telemetry
- EnvironmentAPIKey
- WebhookSyncMembers
